groups.title: Tailwind CSS in Remix
groups.question: You are adding Tailwind to your Remix app and want themes without hard-coded colors. Explain the setup and theming approach.

followUps.Tailwind Setup and PostCSS Integration: How is Tailwind set up in a Remix app?
followUps.CSS Custom Properties and Theming: How do CSS custom properties help with theming?

evidence.text: Tailwind runs as part of the Vite build.
The CSS is imported once at the root so every page gets it.
It can be linked through the root's links so it loads as a stylesheet.
Design tokens are stored as CSS variables.
Changing variables switches themes without JavaScript re-renders.
Using tokens instead of arbitrary values keeps colors consistent.

groups.title: Performance Optimization
groups.question: Your Remix pages flash unstyled content, and a parent route imports a large chart library that every child page downloads. Explain how styles and code are loaded.

followUps.links() Export and Stylesheet Preloading: What does a route's links export do?
followUps.Code Splitting and Route-Based Chunks: How does Remix split code, and how can a parent route undo it?

evidence.text: links returns link tags for stylesheets and preloads.
Each route declares the styles it needs.
Stylesheets load with the HTML, avoiding unstyled content.
Remix splits JavaScript by route automatically.
Libraries imported in a parent route load for every child page.
Importing heavy libraries only where needed keeps other pages light.

groups.title: Web Vitals and Rendering
groups.question: Your Remix app's LCP got worse after someone moved data loading into effects, and the back button loses the user's scroll position. Explain rendering and navigation UX.

followUps.Largest Contentful Paint and SSR: Why does Remix's server rendering help LCP, and how can effects undo it?

evidence.text: Remix sends complete HTML with data on the first request.
The main content appears without waiting for JavaScript.
Fetching data in effects delays content until the browser runs JavaScript.
It restores scroll position on back and forward navigation.
New pages start at the top.
Without it, users lose their place when going back.

groups.title: Image and Asset Optimization
groups.question: Your logo is re-downloaded on every visit and mobile users download huge desktop images. Explain how you would serve assets and images.

followUps.Static Assets in the public Directory: How should static assets be served for good caching?
followUps.Responsive Images with srcset: How do srcset and sizes help mobile users?

evidence.text: Files in public are served as-is.
Assets imported through the build get fingerprinted names.
Fingerprinted files can be cached for a long time and updated by changing names.

notEnough: Only saying you use the public folder.

evidence.text: srcset lists several image sizes.
sizes tells the browser how wide the image will be shown.
The browser picks the smallest suitable image, saving bandwidth and improving LCP.
